notes.title: Original Sountrack as free DLC!
notes.notes:
It's official, the [b]Original Soundtrack[/b] is now being released in stores worldwide! But since you guys already bought the game here you'll be able to download the soundtrack as free DLC! 

If you'd like to support our musicians, the soundtrack will be available for purchase on Bandcamp, Spotify and Google Play, with more services joining in the coming days.

Here's some links to the different stores:

[url=https://copoka.bandcamp.com/album/copoka-original-soundtrack][b]Bandcamp[/b][/url]  (You'll get some free bonus stuff here)
[url=https://play.spotify.com/album/3IBzpfSKzs7eJ1bCK4cr2G?play=true&utm_source=open.spotify.com&utm_medium=open] [b]Spotify[/b][/url]
[url=https://play.google.com/store/music/album?id=Boqawu24i3ti2m377j43aayaxja&tid=song-Tmvggfmzru2qp345tscijykwqey&hl=en] [b]Google Play[/b][/url]
[url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B06XR4V1RY/ref=sr_1_1_rd?_encoding=UTF8&child=B06XR7KR64&qid=1490318621&sr=1-1%3C/a%3E][b]Amazon[/b][/url]
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/copoka-original-soundtrack/id1217628792][b]iTunes[/b][/url]
[url=http://www.deezer.com/album/15689162?utm_source=deezer&utm_content=album-15689162&utm_term=0_1489960523&utm_medium=web][b]Deezer[/b][/url]

Again, thanks to our composers David​, Joakim​ & Pablo​ for creating such an awesome soundtrack!

notes.title: Minor update fixes achievements
notes.notes:
A new update for [i]Copoka[/i] is now live:
[list]
[*] The achievement "Thank You For Playing" now always triggers correctly
[*] The achievement "Been There Done That" now always triggers correctly
[/list]
We'd like to extend a "thank you" to those of you who reported this bug and helped testing the fix!

notes.title: Steam keys for Humble Monthly subscribers now available!
notes.notes:
For those of you who originally received [i]Copoka[/i] as part of the [b]Humble Monthly July[/b] some of you might have been asking if you'll be getting a Steam key. Well we have some good news about that!

You'll now be able to redeem a Steam key for [i]Copoka[/i] if you were subscribed to the Humble Monthly back in July. 

So head on over to your download page over at Humble and [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/home/keys]claim that snazzy Steam key![/url]

Fly free!

notes.title: Copoka has finally flown into the Steam Store!
notes.notes:
[b] Copoka [/b] is now available to purchase on Steam. For this to have happened is truly amazing. None of us ever imagined that the little prototype we pitched about a year ago would go on to become a fully realized game, now to be sold on Steam. But here we are, and for that we are thankful.

As a showing of gratitude, we've decided to sell Copoka at a 20% discount during the first week of release! So from today until February 22nd, you’ll be able to add Copoka to your Steam Library for only 3,99€! 

We hope you enjoy our little game, and rest assured, we've got some exciting news coming for you guys during the next few days... 

Fly safe!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27678614/97fbb38f32697dbaace021a701d29e75a7930cf9.gif[/img]
